title: Closedness of the minimax sublevel set
statement: Let $X \subseteq \bbr$ be a closed set, let $f\colon \bbr \times \bbr \to \bbr$ be a payoff function, and fix a column point $y \in \bbr$ and a threshold $c \in \bbr$. If the map $x \mapsto f(x,y)$ is continuous on $X$, then the minimax sublevel set $\mathrm{sublevel}(X,f,y,c) = X \cap \{x \in \bbr : f(x,y) \le c\}$ is closed.
hypotheses_covered: X is a closed subset of the reals
x \mapsto f(x,y) is continuous on X
fixed column point y and threshold c
replaced:
If $X$ is closed and $f(\cdot,y)$ is continuous on $X$, then
$\mathrm{sublevel}(X,f,y,c)$ is closed.
